name: Dai
oneLiner: DAI is MakerDAO/Sky's dollar stablecoin, minted from crypto and RWA vaults and supported by stablecoin PSM liquidity.
collateral: Multi-collateral Sky/MakerDAO balance sheet: Spark lending exposure (~33%), stablecoins through the PSM (~32%), Grove RWA allocations (~24%), Obex (~5%), core crypto vaults (~4%), Staking Engine (~1%), and legacy RWA (~1%).
pegMechanism: Overcollateralized CDP vaults (auto-liquidated if ratio drops below minimum); LitePSM enabling 1:1 USDC↔DAI swaps; SKY (formerly MKR) acts as backstop (minted and sold to cover bad debt)

oracleRisk.summary: Maker/Sky Vault collateral prices use whitelisted feed medianizers and per-ilk Oracle Security Modules before Spot writes safety-adjusted values into the core accounting system.

branchApplicability.rationale: DAI is issued by a common multi-collateral Vault engine whose separately governed collateral ilks have per-ilk oracle, liquidation-ratio, auction, and debt-ceiling parameters. Those oracle-dependent ilks share one documented Median/OSM/Spot and Dog/Clipper/Vow mechanism branch; fixed-price PSM and balance-sheet allocation routes are not collateral-liquidation branches.

branches.label: Sky governed Vault collateral ilks
branches.summary: Oracle-dependent Sky collateral ilks share the Median-to-OSM-to-Spot price path and use per-ilk Dog/Clipper liquidation parameters.

feeds.path: Per-ilk signed observations -> Median -> OSM -> Spot -> Vat

branches.fallbackBehavior: Each per-ilk OSM retains a delayed current value and queues the next value; if its peek is invalid or Spot is not poked, the Vat keeps the prior safety price and can become stale rather than accepting a fresh invalid value.

collateralParameters.note: Each ilk has its own Spot liquidation ratio, Vat debt ceiling and floor, Dog liquidation penalty and capacity, and dedicated Clipper auction contract; governance can change these parameters.

branches.liquidationMechanism: When a Vault becomes unsafe under its ilk's safety-adjusted Spot value, Dog.bark confiscates the position, assigns its debt to Vow, and promptly starts that ilk's Clipper Dutch auction; auction price decreases over time and can be reset under per-ilk parameters.
branches.backstop: Collateral-auction proceeds cancel the seized debt; residual system debt is recorded in Vow, can first be netted against protocol surplus, and can become eligible for the documented governance-token debt-auction mechanism after the debt-queue delay.
branches.shutdownOrBadDebtBehavior: Uncovered liquidation debt remains in Vow's debt queue and can mature into debt-auction-eligible bad debt. Sky's archived End documentation describes system caging and collateral settlement but marks End deprecated, so this profile does not treat emergency shutdown as a currently active guarantee.

genius.notes: DAI is a protocol stablecoin generated against collateral through CDP vaults and the LitePSM; there is no legal PPSI issuer entity. Whether DAI qualifies as a payment stablecoin under the GENIUS Act definition remains structurally unclear. No PPSI application, state-qualified approval, or issuer-announced intent found as of June 2026. GENIUS rulemaking remains in proposed-rules phase (no final rules, no approvals).

FDIC GENIUS Act NPRMs (Dec 2025, Apr 2026, May 2026)

negativeEvidenceReview.summary: DAI is generated by protocol CDP vaults with no legal PPSI issuer entity. No GENIUS authorization, state-qualified approval, official application, or issuer-announced intent was found. GENIUS rulemaking remains at proposed-rules stage with no approvals granted to any issuer as of June 2026.

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: The Maker Dai Module documentation describes DAI's user-facing token as a standard ERC-20 surface with mint, burn, push, pull, move, approve, and permit operations. The verified Ethereum DAI contract exposes no holder blacklist, freeze, or pause function. DAI's PSM/RWA/custody dependencies can carry upstream freeze exposure, but that is separate from a direct holder-balance control on DAI itself.
blacklistabilityReview.reviewer: SONG Safety Score V9 access review

mintAuthority.summary: DAI minting is vault/module based, with DaiJoin moving Vat.dai into ERC-20 DAI and Maker/Sky governance controlling module authorization and debt ceilings through the Pause process.

controls.label: DaiJoin token adapter
controls.capDescription: DaiJoin mints ERC-20 DAI only against existing Vat.dai balances and burns DAI on join; it is not an unrestricted off-protocol issuer minter.
controls.evidence: Sky Chainlog lists MCD_JOIN_DAI at this address. DAI.wards(DaiJoin) returned 1 at Ethereum block 25294731. eth_getCode confirms contract bytecode present. DaiJoin mints ERC-20 DAI only against Vat.dai balance (no direct unrestricted minting).

controls.label: Maker/Sky Pause Proxy governance executor
controls.capDescription: Maker/Sky governance executes through the Pause Proxy after the current 2-day Pause delay and can change system modules, collateral parameters, and debt ceilings via MCD_VAT.
controls.evidence: MCD_PAUSE (0xbE286431454714F511008713973d3B053A2d38f3) storage slot 4 = 172800 (delay confirmed) at block 25294761. MCD_VAT (0x35D1b3F3D7966A1DFe207aa4514C12a259A0492B).wards(PauseProxy) returned 1 at block 25294731 — confirming governance authority over Vat parameters and debt ceilings. DAI.wards(PauseProxy)=0 is expected: governance path runs through Vat, not direct DAI token. eth_getCode confirms bytecode on all addresses.

review.evidence: At Ethereum block 25294731: DAI.wards(DaiJoin=0x9759A6Ac90977b93B58547b4A71c78317f391a28)=1; Vat.wards(PauseProxy=0xBE8E3e3618f7474F8cB1d074A26afFef007E98FB)=1; MCD_PAUSE.delay()=172800 (storage slot 4). DAI.wards(PauseProxy)=0 is correct: governance authority over DAI supply runs through MCD_VAT (debt ceilings), not direct DAI token minting. All addresses confirmed as contracts.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: DAI is native on Ethereum. Reviewed non-Ethereum deployments span Maker-governed and canonical rollup bridges (Arbitrum, Optimism, Base, zkSync Era, Boba, Metis, Linea, Scroll, Unichain, Taiko, Morph, Hemi, Starknet StarkGate), federation/validator bridges (Polygon PoS, Gnosis OmniBridge, Rootstock TokenBridge, PulseChain, NEAR Rainbow, Wormhole Solana, Orbit Klaytn, Multichain Kava, Celer Astar, Axelar Osmosis, Wanchain Cardano). BSC, Avalanche, Fantom, Moonriver, Moonbeam, Harmony, and Aurora remain unresolved because their live mint authority resolves only to bytecode-less EOAs (Multichain MPC, Binance peg wallet, Avalanche bridge role, Rainbow admin).
bridgeRouteRisk.reviewer: Codex Safety Score V9 bridge review; Kimi P2 control cohort dc-4 (lead dai-makerdao)

routes.reviewNote: The token's live owner() is 0xF68a4b64162906efF0fF6aE34E2bB1Cd42FEf62d, but that address has no BSC bytecode. The bridge-route model cannot honestly encode this EOA as a contract controller, and no separate route-specific mint-controller contract was established. Re-verified 2026-07-20: authority state unchanged (live owner()/bridge-role reads return the same bytecode-less EOAs; no newer MigrateBridgeRole events on Avalanche DAI.e within the last 200k blocks).

The latest MigrateBridgeRole event assigns that role to 0xeb1bb70123b2f43419d070d7fde5618971cc2f8f, which has no Avalanche bytecode, so the bridge-route model cannot honestly encode it as a contract controller. Re-verified 2026-07-20: authority state unchanged (live owner()/bridge-role reads return the same bytecode-less EOAs; no newer MigrateBridgeRole events on Avalanche DAI.e within the last 200k blocks).

The bridge-route model cannot honestly encode this EOA as a contract controller, and no separate route-specific mint-controller contract was established. Re-verified 2026-07-20: authority state unchanged (live owner()/bridge-role reads return the same bytecode-less EOAs; no newer MigrateBridgeRole events on Avalanche DAI.e within the last 200k blocks).

Mint authority cannot be honestly established; the Horizon bridge was exploited in 2022 and 1DAI is depegged legacy. Verified 2026-07-20.

reserveReview.reviewer: OpenAI Codex Safety Score V9 curation
reserveReview.rationale: The direct Sky MakerCore feed reports the complete seven-group debt envelope used by the live reserve adapter. Official protocol documentation establishes the PSM, Agent, crypto-vault, and Staking Engine failure domains; aggregate groups are classified conservatively without inventing look-through asset weights or liquidity terms.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Relative debt reported by the Sky MakerCore group endpoint and mapped through the canonical sky-makercore adapter
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The PSM group combines external stablecoins without publishing constituent weights in the group feed. The remaining groups are classified at their protocol or obligor failure domain and are not represented as direct tracked-stablecoin dependencies.

nonLinkDispositions.rationale: The published group combines several PSM assets without per-asset weights.
Grove is a Sky Agent allocation into institutional-credit strategies, not a direct wrapper around one tracked stablecoin.
Spark is an allocator and lending-protocol position with multiple deployment counterparties, not a direct wrapper around one tracked stablecoin.
Obex is an Agent allocation across supported institutional stablecoin projects rather than one canonical tracked reserve asset.
The Core bucket is a multi-collateral crypto-vault pool, not one canonical tracked reserve asset.
The Staking Engine bucket is collateralized by SKY positions in LockStake Engine vaults, not by another tracked stablecoin.
The legacy RWA bucket represents external legal structures and obligors rather than a direct tracked-stablecoin dependency.
